items: 【Ultralight & Effortless】Weighs just 1 lb! Ditch those heavy bags! This super-light tote is your perfect companion for commutes, travel, work, or quick errands.

【25L Spacious & Organized】Holds everything you need and more! Features 12 dedicated pockets, including a padded laptop compartment (holds up to 15.6" laptops), plus extra space for water bottles, books, files, clothes, electronics, and essentials. Keep it all neatly organized.

【Giant Water Bottle Pockets】1 inner sleeve + 2 outer adjustable cinch pockets grip your largest tumblers & travel mugs securely—no more “will it fit?” stress. Enjoy hassle-free hydration everywhere you go.
【Travel Smarter】Effortlessly slide the back trolley sleeve onto your suitcase handle for gliding through airports. Fits most airline's personal item rules (16" L × 12.5" H × 5" W).
【Durable & Easy Care】Made with LOVEVOOK’s high-performance composite fabric for serious durability and light rain protection. Machine washable without losing its structure.
